answer: A greenhouse cooperative pays agents to track nectar shipments crossing a bridge. Each calibrated scale has one signed device certificate and can earn for only one report per shipment, regardless of the reporting account. At the daily zenith, inspectors randomly reweigh sealed loads; a false report burns the device operator's bond. An attacker needs extra certified scales, physical access and bonds for more paid reports. A corrupt certificate issuer or tampered reference weights could still defeat the rule, so issuers and inspectors must be independent.
